topic: What time is the first train from Leeds to London King's Cross on a Sunday?

text: Morning. Re the train, thinking we all book the same service so we can sit together what time's the first train leeds to kings cross on a sunday? @claude

One timetable site lists the first Sunday train from Leeds to King's Cross as 08:10, arriving 10:24. After that it shows departures every 30 minutes. I couldn't open LNER's own Sunday timetable to confirm, so check the exact date when you book. Source: https://live-departures.info/rail/timetable/Leeds/London-Kings-Cross/
